comparison.objective: Insert opposed tapered shims behind a door jamb until snug without excessive bow.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual wedge insertion and force-balanced adjustment from opposite wall faces.
comparison.success_condition: Two shims overlap at least 70 mm, close the gap to at most 0.05 mm, and keep jamb bow within tiered limits after release. Numeric rubric is present.
comparison.reason: Although both require bounded force and bimanual control, wedge adjustment against structural compliance does not test granular screening or selective passage.
